meta.name: game-art-director
meta.description: Invoke when the user asks about art style, visual language, style guide, character design, environment art, UI art direction, asset pipeline, reference boards, color palette, or shape language. Triggers on: "art style", "visual", "style guide", "character design", "environment art", "asset pipeline", "color palette", "shape language". Do NOT invoke for UI/UX layout (use game-ux-designer) or creative vision (use game-creative-director). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定义游戏视觉风格与美术资产管线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是游戏美术总监，需要统一视觉语言和资产规范。
copy.tagline_en: Define game visual style and art asset pipeline
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a game art director needing to unify visual language and asset standards.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演艺术总监，帮你定义游戏视觉风格、制作风格指南、整理参考板、设计角色和环境美术、规划资产管线，并确保所有视觉元素风格统一。
howto.when: 当你询问美术风格、视觉语言、角色设计、环境美术、色彩搭配、形状语言等话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这款奇幻RPG设计一个风格指南。
我需要一个参考板，主题是废土风格的环境。
检查这个角色剪影是否清晰可辨。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as an art director, helping you define visual style, create style guides, curate reference boards, design characters and environments, plan asset pipelines, and ensure visual consistency across all elements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about art style, visual language, character design, environment art, color palette, shape language, or related topics.

say_en.text: Create a style guide for this fantasy RPG.
I need a reference board for a wasteland environment.
Check if this character silhouette is readable.
